blurb: Paradis Marin offers camping with 148 sites including 33 with water and electricity services. Guests can engage in sea kayaking, paddle surfing, scuba diving with their own equipment, and marine mammal observation. The site provides easy access for kayak launching and diving, with facilities such as showers, toilets, and picnic tables.
extraNote: Reservations accepted by phone only from April 1 each year · Only serviced sites can be reserved; other sites are first-come, first-served · Dogs allowed on site but must be leashed and waste picked up; not allowed in cabins · At the camping site, check-in at the reception area.
